summary_en: User Local will acquire up to 270,000 shares (1.7% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of JPY 400 million through market purchase from November 13 to December 23, 2026, followed by cancellation on December 25, 2026, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution on Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
User Local's board of directors has approved the acquisition and cancellation of treasury stock. The company will purchase up to 270,000 shares, representing 1.7% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock (15,614,598 shares as of October 31, 2026), for a maximum of JPY 400 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 13 to December 23, 2026. The acquired shares will be cancelled on December 25, 2026.

The company stated that the acquisition and cancellation are intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, while enabling flexible capital policy implementation in response to changing business conditions. The cancellation will reduce outstanding shares by 1.7%, calculated as 270,000 shares divided by the denominator of 15,614,598 shares.
